chunks: They say: 'If we now go back to Madina, the stronger will turn the weaker out.' But power belongs to God, His Apostle and the faithful, though the hypocrites do not know.
ai.seo_question: What did the hypocrites say about returning to Medina and who possesses true power?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Munafiqun, this verse captures the arrogant declaration of the hypocrites upon their return to Medina, where they boast that the 'stronger' will expel the 'weaker,' reflecting the internal power struggles of the early Muslim community. Shia scholarship emphasizes that while they claim worldly dominance, true 'Izzah (honor/power) is divinely anchored in God, His Prophet, and the faithful, exposing their ignorance of spiritual reality. This contrast underscores the transient nature of their political maneuvering against the enduring authority of the believers.
